title: Jerebu
subject: the haze week when the air index passes two hundred, schools shut and the sun hangs over the Klang river like a dull orange coin
caption: Malaysian stoner doom, slow fuzz-riff doom metal. A heavily down-tuned fuzz guitar in C standard cycling one slow riff over and over; an overdriven bass doubling the guitar note for note; loose, heavy live drums leaning on the ride bell and floor toms with long gaps between snare hits, and a long jammed outro. Thick and murky, fuzz guitar and bass forward and saturated, the vocal set back with a short slap delay. A low, hazy male voice chanting the lines in a narrow range and breaking into a long howl on the chorus. 66 BPM, C minor. Heavy, choked and sardonic. No blast beats, no screamed hardcore vocals, no fast tempo, no clean pop chorus, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - one short two-bar fuzz riff, feedback ringing]

[Verse 1]
Matahari macam syiling oren
Tergantung atas Sungai Klang
Bacaan IPU dua ratus tiga
Sekolah tutup, budak main dalam rumah

[Chorus]
Jerebu, jerebu
Tarik nafas, rasa abu
Kereta putih jadi kelabu
Langit pun pakai topeng muka

[Verse 2]
Mak cik kedai jual topeng muka
Tiga ringgit sekeping, dah habis
Berita sebut angin dari selatan
Berita sama macam tahun lepas

[Bridge - riff slows further, drums thin to ride bell]
Satu bandar batuk serentak
Satu bandar tutup tingkap

[Chorus]
Jerebu, jerebu
Tarik nafas, rasa abu
Matahari tinggal bulat oren
Kita pun tunggu, macam tahun lepas

[Outro - long jammed riff sinking into feedback]
Jerebu...
